top_repos.name: BipedalWalker-PPO-STM32
top_repos.description: Reinforcement Learning meets Embedded Systems: Training a bipedal robot with PPO and deploying it on STM32 microcontroller using TFLite Micro

top_repos.name: NeuroPlan-Neural-Transformer-Based-VLSI-Floorplanning
top_repos.description: A hybrid deep learning approach combining neural networks and transformer architectures to understand and optimize VLSI floorplanning. This project explores spatial reasoning, layout prediction, and design optimization using modern AI techniques.

top_repos.name: depth-slam
top_repos.description: Building visual SLAM from scratch with Intel RealSense D435 — ORB features, metric depth, keyframe database, and FLANN re-localisation toward memory-based navigation.

top_repos.name: SO100-Motion-Recorder-Playback
top_repos.description: This project uses two Python scripts to simplify robot motion control. The first script captures and stores robot positions in JSON format, and the second script plays back those saved positions to move the robot through the recorded sequence.

top_repos.name: ESP32-OTA-Update-via-GitHub
top_repos.description: This project enables Over-the-Air (OTA) updates for ESP32 devices by fetching firmware binaries from GitHub repositories. With this solution, you can seamlessly deploy updates to your ESP32 devices remotely without the need for physical access.

top_repos.name: SynapticCircuits
top_repos.description: AI for Analog Circuit Understanding & Debugging

top_repos.name: AirWrite-Ring
top_repos.description: AirWrite-Ring is a smart wearable using XIAO ESP32S3 and MPU6050 to recognize letters drawn in the air. A 1D-CNN model runs on-device to infer gestures when the touch sensor is pressed, sending the detected character over BLE for real-time interaction.
